answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 796 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the gale. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the trellis queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The pulse index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 11 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
